lead: Aparna Sen is a widely followed Indian film director, born on 25 October 1945 in Kolkata.
As of 2026, she is 80 years old, and her birth date places her under the Scorpio sign.
She is associated with work such as 36 Chowringhee Lane, Mr. and Mrs. Iyer and 15 Park Avenue and has been recognised with the Padma Shri in arts.
The sections that follow break down Aparna Sen's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
